instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Run tool:renew-a-tls-certificate", and give it hostname, address, ssh_port, admin_user, knownHost, host.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:renew-a-tls-certificate and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: An answer with the fields hostname, certificate_present, system_trust_and_hostname_verified, not_before_local, not_after_local, issuer, serial, private_key_mode.
